findings.text: follow-on: the arm asserts `_provider_jitter(recorded, []) == pytest.approx(bl.STAMP_RESOLUTION_SECONDS)`, comparing the function's output against the very constant the function uses as its floor, so the assertion holds for any value of that constant and cannot catch a wrongly-sized floor.

justifications.evidence: the measure_live_jitter-head.log/-base.log pair reads the real codex-sub readings and both recorded lifts, showing the flapping lift ends cause reset at base and stays in force at head.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/budget_lift.py:802 follows the module's private-helper idiom with a docstring and Sequence typing, and the new names carry no plan label or version.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/budget_lift.py:799 returns `moved > _provider_jitter(...)` so a stamp that wobbles less than the measured jitter no longer ends the lift, which is the deliverable.
